title: 油价跌了：美债却稳了，市场在悄悄转向
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.zh: 保罗，欢迎你。从欧洲的角度看，我们想知道油价下跌是否会稍微提升风险偏好。我想知道最近的发展

segments.en: around long bonds, do they add to risk appetite a little bit for stocks? If we are seeing a cap on on long bonds for whatever reason, what's your assessment? Yeah, morning, Anna. So partly,

segments.en: that's helped by the oil price news as well, of course. So, declining oil prices signals slightly slower inflation, and therefore, that's good for the back end of the yield curve
segments.zh: 当然，油价下跌也起到了作用。油价下跌意味着通胀略低，因此对收益率曲线的长端有利。

segments.en: in particular. So, Scott Besson, I'll be pleased with that, but I think he'll also be pleased if he passes the market metrics a little bit more carefully than looking at the outright yield numbers
segments.zh: 斯科特·贝森特对此会感到满意，但我想，如果他更仔细地观察市场指标，而不是只看名义收益率，他也会感到满意。

segments.en: to see his efforts to come, things may be working. And so, if you look at the swap spread, for example, which is the difference between interest rate swaps and treasury yields, so the treasury haven't
segments.zh: 看看他的努力是否在起作用。例如，如果看互换利差，即利率互换与国债收益率之间的差额，国债并没有

segments.en: been outperforming relative to the interest rate spots and sort of making it a less negative difference. So, that shows that there's some stronger appetite for bonds relative to those swaps.
segments.zh: 相对于利率互换表现不佳，而是使负差变小。这表明相对于互换，对债券的需求更强。

segments.en: Another thing is in the options market where, again, you're seeing some signs that there's a bit of stabilization. We had a write-up of a report from Sister's Al, I think, as well, talking about how they
segments.zh: 另一个是在期权市场，你也看到一些稳定的迹象。我们有一份来自Sister's Al的报告，谈到他们如何

segments.en: flip to more bullish on the long bonds thinking about the positioning of momentum following traders.
segments.zh: 转为更看多长期债券，考虑到动量交易者的持仓。
